reviewer: Independent adversarial refuter: downstream guards and actual user impact
scope: Fresh shipped-code reads, routed project instructions, current new re-audit artifacts, four independently executed new scripts. No old audit treated as authority; no private course materials, live API, browser, native Anki, or production edits.
lineNumberConvention: All bare line references name Nursing-Study-Suite v16.6.html. Ranges refer to read source spans, not browser coverage.
severityMeaning: Qualitative impact within this local study app; high denotes potential content/provenance integrity, not a measured clinical incident or security severity.
